finalText:
I went through all 380 commits and 127 merged PRs since 4.1. Most really was noise: dependency bumps, refactors, test fixes. I found one new feature and eleven real bug fixes, and added them to `CHANGELOG.md` under a new 4.2.0 section.

The big one: webhook deliveries now retry with backoff instead of dying after one try. Worth calling out to users: expired tokens now correctly return 401 instead of 403, and request bodies are no longer written to the logs in full (that one's a privacy fix). No breaking changes this time.
